think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/exception values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/auto/special mode) rather than just scaling behavior. 3) Determine whether such a value breaks the natural numeric ordering by switching the knob into a qualitatively different mode. 4) If a sentinel exists, mark as special and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise mark as not special.
